doc.title: Scott Jimmy — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: His father's drinking clubs
summary: He did not go to his father's clubs, which were just drinking and menacing talk.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: I know your dad liked to go to clubs and hang out.
Would you go to those clubs with him ever and hear music in those clubs?
Those clubs he went to? No.
They were just drinking and talking menacingly to me. It didn’t mean anything to me, listening to them, because they wasn’t talking about nothing that was interesting enough to listen.
